coefficient_conventions.face_and_MS: All coefficients are one in F2; the resulting cochains have phase coefficient 1/2.
coefficient_conventions.quarter_cups: Each signed AST has coefficient sign/4. Cups are ordered signed integer cups, with canonical lifts of binary leaves.
coefficient_conventions.whole_standard_operations: Bockstein arguments and integer differentials retain their complete displayed scope. In particular beta acts on the complete binary two-term lower obstruction, not on a sum of separate integer lifts.

monomial_rule: Hex mask bit i selects alphabet entry i. Multiply selected binary factors, then add all monomials modulo two. No omitted terms.
lift_carry_identity: For binary x,y,z,t, (x xor y)*(z xor t)/4 = (xz+xt+yz+yt)/4 - (xyz+xyt+xzt+yzt)/2 modulo1. The coefficient-one xyzt term drops modulo1.
